title: StationMasterData
description: Master record for an air-quality monitoring station. Stored in a PostgreSQL database and looked up by stationId at runtime to enrich incoming AirQualityRawReading messages.

installDate.description: Date when the station was commissioned.

stationType.description: Station classification according to EU Directive 2008/50/EC.

location.description: Fixed installation coordinates of the station.

frostThingId.description: FROST-Server @iot.id of the STA Thing entity corresponding to this station. Populated after initial sync.

frostDatastreamIds.description: Maps each pollutant to its FROST Datastream @iot.id. Populated after initial sync.
